title: OpenAI says it didn't fire three researchers for "raising safety concerns or speaking out", but for violating "clear policies on handling sensitive information" (Michael Considine/CNBC)
summary: Michael Considine / CNBC: OpenAI says it didn't fire three researchers for “raising safety concerns or speaking out”, but for violating “clear policies on handling sensitive information” — OpenAI on Friday defended its decision to fire three safety researchers, saying they had committed a “significant breach of trust.”
contentText:
Michael Considine / CNBC :

OpenAI says it didn't fire three researchers for “raising safety concerns or speaking out”, but for violating “clear policies on handling sensitive information”   —  OpenAI on Friday defended its decision to fire three safety researchers, saying they had committed a “significant breach of trust.”
